channel.title: Niger - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Niger, every source cited.

item.title: Algerian fuel trucks arrive in Agadez
item.description: 60 tankers delivered fuel to Niger under joint military escort, easing supply issues.

item.title: Niger forces neutralise seven mercenaries
item.description: Military operations in October recovered weapons, communication devices, and destroyed armed group bases.

item.title: Niger journalist Moussa Kaka detained for two months
item.description: Moussa Kaka, a journalist for radio television Saraounia, has been held incommunicado since August 31.
